Capability states
Five states · same five everywhere
The state set never changes between directions — only the colour values do. available · partial · deferred · blocked · critical render as a 6 px LED in the rail and sidebar, as a small uppercase chip in the canvas, and as the leading colour of any badge attached.
Available
Wired and operator-usable. LED is the canonical green.
available
Inventory
Partial
Some sub-tools live, others not yet. LED amber.
partial
Comparison
Deferred
In catalogue + roadmap, not wired in V1. LED grey, label italic.
deferred
Zero-Touch Provisioning
Blocked
Unreachable — RBAC, contract, license. LED red, label inked red.
blocked
Security
Critical
Available + actively failing. Solid critical chip — never used as a state, only as a signal.
critical
fra-leaf-04 · holdover
Domain accents
Four domains · one mark per domain
Domain colour is structural orientation only. It appears on rail group separators, the left strip of every dashboard card, and the leading dot of every Cortex breadcrumb. It is never used to mean health, severity, or status.
